description: A living room media wall photographed at standing eye-level with a normal lens, capturing a wide establishing view of the full TV wall and entertainment console. The right section transitions to a large-format warm cream travertine marble slab — creamy beige with fine grey veining and a warm, sandy tone — spanning most of the wall height. A large flat-screen television is wall-mounted centered on the travertine section. On the console surface from left to right: a matte dark charcoal ceramic vase holding a sparse spray of dried cherry branches with tiny white flowers; a flat black decorative bowl with a small mound of warm yellow-orange citrus fruits; a matte white ceramic bottle-shaped vase and a slimmer white cylindrical vase grouped at the far right. A large-leafed tropical plant in a matte black pot stands at the left foreground. On the dark slat wall section, a slim vertical matte black wall form with an interior geometric screen diffuser emits warm amber light. Natural daylight rakes obliquely across the travertine wall from an off-frame window, casting soft architectural shadows. The floor is a large-format ivory or cream stone tile, with a low-pile ivory textured rug beneath the coffee table.
